description: This Java source file defines a final class DOMSettingsBuilder responsible for constructing and writing an XML document representing application settings. It builds various XML nodes for different settings categories such as window, files, options, display, logger, clipboard format, and icons, and serializes the complete XML structure to a given output file.

classes.name: DOMSettingsBuilder
classes.description: Final class providing methods to build an XML representation of application settings and serialize it to a file.

methods.name: buildSettings
methods.description: Builds an XML document of settings and writes it to the specified output file, updating progress along the way.

methods.name: buildWindow
methods.description: Creates an XML node representing window-related settings such as size, position, and state.

methods.name: buildFiles
methods.description: Creates an XML node representing file paths and ECU definition files.

methods.name: buildOptions
methods.description: Creates an XML node representing various application options and configurations.

methods.name: buildTableDisplay
methods.description: Creates an XML node for table display settings including fonts, colors, and cell sizes.

methods.name: buildLogger
methods.description: Creates an XML node for logger configuration including window size, protocol, and plugin ports.

methods.name: buildTableClipboardFormat
methods.description: Creates an XML node defining clipboard table formats.

methods.name: buildIcons
methods.description: Creates an XML node for application icon scale settings.
